content.rendered: SFPL seeks a Chief Innovation and Information Officer (CIIO), a visionary and mission-driven technology executive ready to shape the future of digital public services in libraries. This role is ideal for tech leaders who want to build systems that serve equity, access, and impact at scale. Technology is core to SFPL’s operations, equity agenda, and patron experience; this role leads the digital backbone of San Francisco’s library system.

The Chief Digital Officer (CDO) is responsible for setting and executing the City-County’s enterprise digital strategy and ensuring that technology systems, digital experience, workforce capability, and enterprise applications work in harmony to deliver modern, equitable, accessible, and secure services to residents, businesses, visitors, and internal users.
